tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background. White on light sections, ground on dark sections.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, alternate sections and the surface media sits on.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, strong text, button labels. On bg-page and bg-panel in both themes (light 18.9:1 on white, dark 18.0:1 on ground).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Long reading text on bg-page and bg-panel (light 11.7:1 on white, dark 10.1:1 on ground).

tokens.name: text-meta
tokens.usage: Mono labels, kickers, metadata, inactive switch options. On bg-page and bg-panel (light 5.5:1 on white, 5.1:1 on paper-inset; dark 5.8:1 on ground, 5.3:1 on ground-raised).

tokens.name: line-default
tokens.usage: Neutral 1px hairline: tag borders, table rules, quiet dividers where the prism would be too loud.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger neutral hairline. The site defines it on light only; the dark value mirrors the light strength on ink-on-dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primitive. Page background on light; primary button fill.

tokens.name: paper-inset
tokens.usage: Primitive. Panels, alternate sections, media backgrounds; secondary button fill.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary panel, one step deeper than paper-inset. Never text. ink-meta on it is 4.49:1, just under 4.5: keep labels on it at ink-body or ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primitive. Text and fills on white; primary button hover fill; switch active fill; cursor dot.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Primitive. Long body text on white.

tokens.name: ink-meta
tokens.usage: Primitive. Labels, metadata, secondary text on white.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Legacy accent. Hover fill only, never text, never a border.

tokens.name: prism-1
tokens.usage: Prism stop 1 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-2
tokens.usage: Prism stop 2 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-3
tokens.usage: Prism stop 3 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-4
tokens.usage: Prism stop 4 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-5
tokens.usage: Prism stop 5 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-6
tokens.usage: Prism stop 6 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: prism-7
tokens.usage: Prism stop 7 of 7. Only ever inside the prism gradient, as a 1px line. Never a fill, never text.

styles.name: display-giant
styles.usage: Fluid: clamp(72px, 11vw, 160px) via the type-display-giant token or .lb-display-giant. One per page at most.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Fluid: clamp(22px, 2.1vw, 30px). Card and block titles.

styles.name: body-lead
styles.sample: Senior Product Designer working on complex B2B SaaS, financial products and AI.

styles.name: body-default
styles.sample: The test could not be made faster, so the wait had to be made understandable.

styles.name: label-kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase. Section kickers above headings. Line height is not set on the site; 1.4 is the specimen's.

tokens.name: radius-default
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, cards, switches. The maximum: nothing is rounder.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Cursor, favicon ring and sound dot only.

shadow.note: There are no shadows. Depth comes from lines and contrast.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every surface. Never add a shadow.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every line: prism borders, hairlines, separators.

tokens.name: border-width-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button border on hover only.

gradient.note: The prism. Only ever a 1px line: borders, separators, the header's bottom rule, the cursor ring, the favicon ring.

tokens.name: prism
tokens.usage: Horizontal prism. 1px lines only, never a fill or behind text.

tokens.name: prism-sm
tokens.usage: Four-stop short range: the tertiary button hover underline and lines under ~120px.

typescale.note: The fluid sizes the site ships. The Typography view shows their desktop maximum.
